# eslint-plugin-tailwindcss 2026.07.02

- [Contributing to `esLint-plugin-tailwindcss`](https://github.com/francoismassart/eslint-plugin-tailwindcss/blob/v4/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Enforces a consistent order for the Tailwind CSS classnames, based on the compiler](https://github.com/francoismassart/eslint-plugin-tailwindcss/blob/v4/docs/rules/classnames-order.md)
- [Warns about `-` prefixed classnames using arbitrary values](https://github.com/francoismassart/eslint-plugin-tailwindcss/blob/v4/docs/rules/enforces-negative-arbitrary-values.md)
- [Avoid using multiple Tailwind CSS classnames when not required](https://github.com/francoismassart/eslint-plugin-tailwindcss/blob/v4/docs/rules/enforces-shorthand.md)
- [Forbid using arbitrary values in classnames](https://github.com/francoismassart/eslint-plugin-tailwindcss/blob/v4/docs/rules/no-arbitrary-value.md)
- [Avoid contradicting Tailwind CSS classnames](https://github.com/francoismassart/eslint-plugin-tailwindcss/blob/v4/docs/rules/no-contradicting-classname.md)
- [Detects classnames which do not belong to Tailwind CSS](https://github.com/francoismassart/eslint-plugin-tailwindcss/blob/v4/docs/rules/no-custom-classname.md)
- [Avoid unjustified arbitrary classnames](https://github.com/francoismassart/eslint-plugin-tailwindcss/blob/v4/docs/rules/no-unnecessary-arbitrary-value.md)
